business_summary: Kamakura Shinsho, Ltd. operates a portal site that provides information services related to end of life in Japan. The company offers funerals services, including li Sougi, a funeral consultation and request website; finding monks services under the Good Monks name; farewell and memorial services under the Story name; li Ohaka, a portal site for things related to graves; finding services for grave, closing a grave, funerals, inheritance, and end-of-life planning under the LifeDot name; and specialized service for relocating and closing graves. It also provides ocean scattering of ashes under the Blue Ocean Ceremony name; information on tombstones and stonemasons; li Butsudan, a portal site for Buddhist altars and religious items; Good Inheritance, a portal site for consultation and referral for inheritance procedures; Guide services for Estimating Inheritance Costs and Inheritance Lawyers; eAdministrative Scrivener; Tax Accountant; estate cleanup; and lawyer search services. In addition, the company offers Good Care, a directory of nursing care facilities and senior living homes; My Post-Death Procedures, an end-of-life planning service for single individuals; Monthly End-of-Life Planning, a business information magazine for the funeral and memorial service industry; Manabi to Shigoto, a reskilling and career development service; and seminars and courses, and web marketing consulting services. Further, it engages in real estate, insurance, and financial businesses. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
